Aug 20, 2021

Having considered the Joint Motion to Continue the status hearing and the prior representations by defense counsel that Defendant had previously waived his right to a preliminary hearing on the record, it is hereby ordered that the August 16, 2021 status hearing is continued to October 12, 2021 at 3:00 p.m. before Magistrate Judge G. Michael Harvey. The time between August 16, 2021 and August 20, 2021 shall be excluded from calculation under the Speedy Trial Act due to the pendency of the motion to continue. The time between August 20, 2021 and October 12, 2021 shall be excluded from calculation under the Speedy Trial Act, as the Court finds that the ends of justice served by the granting of such continuance outweigh the best interests of the public and Defendant in a speedy trial, as the continuance will provide the parties with additional time to engage in the discovery process and for Defendant to review the government's plea offer.
